toast_frame_step_fps_fallback: {{icon:info}} Frame step using fallback {fps} fps (actual rate unknown)
toast_random_source_empty: {{icon:random}} Nothing to pick in {name}, using your whole library
toast_random_source_missing: {{icon:random}} The selected random source is unavailable, using your whole library
panel_settings_long_press_desc: Press and hold on the video to play at 2x speed (works best on mobile/touch devices)
toast_at_least_one_item_type: {{icon:warning}} At least one item type must be selected
toast_native_poster_tags_saved: {{icon:tag}} Native poster preference saved. Reopen the library or restart your TV app to refresh its posters.
panel_size_grip_hint: Drag to resize, or use the arrow keys
panel_shortcuts_footer: {{icon:info}} Click a key to change it. Press <kbd>Backspace</kbd> while listening to reset to default, or <kbd>Delete</kbd> to disable it.
panel_settings_custom_pause_screen_desc: Show a stylized screen when videos are paused.
panel_settings_auto_pip_desc: Automatically enter PiP when switching tabs
panel_settings_auto_skip_depends: {{icon:info}} Depends on Intro-Skipper Plugin being available
panel_settings_subtitles_position_note: Requires Jellyfin subtitle style set to Custom in subtitle settings
panel_settings_subtitles_format_warning: These styles do not work for the subtitle format the current video is using.
panel_settings_random_button_scope_curre: Use the playlist or collection I'm viewing
On a playlist or collection page, pick from its items instead of the whole library
panel_settings_random_button_source_miss: (selected playlist or collection no longer exists)
panel_settings_ui_watch_progress_desc: Display watch progress on item detail pages. Choose display mode below.
panel_settings_ui_file_sizes_desc: Display total file size on item detail pages.
panel_settings_ui_audio_languages_desc: Display available audio languages on detail pages.
panel_settings_ui_native_poster_tags_des: Draw your tags into poster images for native apps such as Android TV that can't show them otherwise, using your tag choices, Status badges, Corners or Bands layout, and group order. Caption, Summary and Minimal use Corners. Web clients keep the usual overlays. Reopen the library or restart the TV app to see a change.
panel_settings_ui_language_tags_desc: Display audio and subtitle languages as flags or codes, with optional Dual/Multi badges.
panel_settings_ui_quality_tags_desc: Display 4K, HDR, etc., tags on posters.
panel_settings_ui_quality_tags_audio_lan: Preferred audio language for the sound tag
The sound tag (Atmos, DTS, 5.1, ...) describes the best track in this language. Titles with no audio in it fall back to their best track overall.
panel_settings_ui_rating_tags_desc: Display selected rating sources on posters.
panel_settings_ui_age_rating_tags_desc: Display the age rating (PG-13, TV-MA, FSK 12, ...) as a colour-coded badge on posters.
panel_settings_ui_logo_tags_desc: Show the streaming service, TV network or studio of each title as a small logo on posters.
panel_settings_ui_logo_tags_include: Your administrator chooses what the logo shows for movies and series (streaming service, network or studio) and how many logos a title can have.
panel_settings_ui_status_tags_desc: Badge posters with what is new, trending, airing next or a season milestone, without replacing the poster image.
panel_settings_ui_status_tags_new_releas: New Movie / New Series / New Episode
panel_settings_ui_status_tags_schedule: Airing Today / Airs / Returns / Coming Soon
panel_settings_ui_status_tags_milestones: New Season / Premiere / Finale / Complete Season
admin_status_tags_description: Badge posters with what is new, trending, airing next or a season milestone, without replacing the poster image. Web client only; Native Poster Tags do not draw them.
admin_status_tags_priority: One badge per poster, first match wins (the order per card type is in the documentation). Users can override the family switches in their personal settings; the day windows apply to everyone.
admin_status_tags_schedule: Show Airing Today / Airs / Returns / Coming Soon
admin_status_tags_schedule_description: When a series’ next episode airs (needs the TMDB API key), and Coming Soon for movies and series that have not premiered yet.
admin_status_tags_milestones: Show New Season / Premiere / Finale / Complete Season
admin_status_tags_milestones_description: Season milestones from the library’s episode dates; Season Finale and Series Finale need the TMDB API key.
admin_status_tags_series_status_descript: The series status, when no other badge applies. Jellyfin supplies Returning and Ended; TMDB can refine Ended to Cancelled. Off by default.
panel_settings_ui_tag_layout_corners: Corners: each group in a corner of the poster
panel_settings_ui_tag_layout_bands: Bands: a strip along the top and bottom, the middle stays clear
panel_settings_ui_tag_layout_caption: Caption: tags in a line below the poster
panel_settings_ui_tag_layout_summary: Summary: one short fact pill, every tag on hover
panel_settings_ui_tag_layout_minimal: Minimal: status, quality dots and score, the rest on hover
panel_settings_ui_tag_density_desc: Compact shortens quality labels (DV, Atmos) and hides the critic score next to a community score.
panel_settings_ui_tag_edge_desc: How close the Corners layout puts tags to the poster edge. Flush tags touch the edge and follow the poster's rounded corners.
panel_settings_ui_tag_editor_desc: Higher groups win when space is short. Open a group to choose where it goes in this layout and how many tags it shows.
panel_settings_ui_tag_editor_nothing_to_: Nothing to choose for this group
panel_settings_ui_custom_tags_desc: Chips your administrator sets up for Jellyfin tags and collections, such as Remaster for items tagged 4K Remaster.
panel_settings_ui_custom_tags_include: Your administrator chooses which tags and collections get a chip, and their colours.
panel_settings_ui_custom_tags_none: No custom tags are set up on this server yet.
toast_tag_layout_reset: Tag layout reset to the defaults
panel_settings_ui_tag_style_preset_desc: Colour preset for poster tags. Colours your server admin changed stay on top.
panel_media_tags_moved: Media Tags moved to its own section
panel_media_tags_moved_desc: Layouts, tag groups, status badges, rules and colours now live under Media Tags.
panel_media_tags_layout_desc: Your default look. Item locks and matching rules come first.
panel_media_tags_switches_desc: These apply whatever the layout, rule or lock.
panel_media_tags_badges_desc: Which badges the Status group may show. A poster shows one at a time, the most timely first.
panel_media_tags_badges_off: Status tags are off, so none of these show. Turn Status on in Groups.
panel_media_tags_badges_to_groups: Status position and limit in Groups
panel_media_tags_badges_include: Choose its badges on the Status badges tab.
panel_media_tags_badge_trending_desc: Popular right now, with its rank
panel_media_tags_badge_leaving_desc: Items the server will remove soon (Maintainerr or the administrator's leaving collections), with the days left
panel_media_tags_badge_leaving_unavailab: needs a Leaving soon source on the server
panel_media_tags_badge_direct_play_desc: Movies and episodes this browser can't play directly (Transcode / Won't direct play); web only, checked for cards on screen whose media Jellyfin has already probed (.strm items are always skipped)
panel_media_tags_badge_windows_admin: Change the time windows on the configuration page
panel_media_tags_colours_presets_off: Users can't pick their own preset. Turn on "Let users pick their own preset" in the colour editor to offer it.
panel_media_tags_server_desc: These apply to everyone, so they live on the plugin configuration page. Only administrators see this tab.
panel_media_tags_server_defaults_desc: The layout, density, group order, limits and rules new accounts start with.
panel_media_tags_server_colours_desc: Each group's colours, and whether users may pick a preset.
panel_media_tags_server_cache_desc: The tag data the server keeps for every item, and a rebuild.
panel_media_tags_server_native_desc: Tags drawn into poster images for apps such as Android TV and Swiftfin.
panel_media_tags_preview_precedence: Locks override rules; rules override shape looks; shape looks override your default.
panel_media_tags_preview_hover_hidden: Hide Tags on Hover is on: your cards fade their tags while you hover them.
panel_media_tags_preview_none: No tags: every group is off
tag_looks_locked_desc: Always keep the look they had when locked
tag_looks_error_value: Choose or enter a value for every condition.
tag_item_editor_source_shape: Your look for this card shape
tag_item_editor_source_unknown: Not known (the item's data did not load)
tag_item_editor_no_tags: This item's tags are not loaded yet. Your changes still apply once they are.
tag_item_editor_scope_series: This series and its seasons and episodes
tag_item_editor_keep: Keep this look for this item
tag_item_editor_keep_hint: Changes here are kept only while this is on: rule and default changes never alter a kept look. Turn it off to let them decide again.
tag_item_editor_everyone_hint: Every user's cards of this item get this look unless they keep their own. Rules never change it.
tag_item_editor_server_hint: This is the item's server-wide look: every user gets it unless they keep their own look for the item.
tag_item_editor_not_kept: Turn on Keep this look to keep these changes.
tag_item_editor_unlocked: {name} follows your rules and default again
tag_item_editor_nothing_kept: Nothing was kept: the look follows your rules and default
tag_item_editor_error: Could not save the look. Try again.
tag_item_editor_unsupported: Media Tags do not appear on this kind of item.
tag_looks_save_failed_toast: Could not save the tag look change
tag_looks_hub_desc: Item locks come first, then the first matching rule, otherwise your default layout.
tag_looks_no_rules: No rules yet: every card uses your default layout.
tag_looks_no_locks: No locked items. Lock an item from its detail page to keep its look.
tag_looks_limit: You have {count} rules, the most there can be.
tag_looks_edit_hint: Keeps the rule's place and On/Off state.
tag_looks_add_hint: Added at the end of the list.
panel_settings_ui_people_tags_desc: Display age, birthplace, and deceased status for cast members.
panel_settings_ui_hide_tags_on_hover_des: Fade tag overlays when hovering over cards so buttons are easier to see
panel_settings_ui_remove_continue_watchi: Add Remove from Continue Watching & Next Up Buttons

Adds a Remove option to the action sheet on Continue Watching and Next Up items. Removed items appear in Hidden Content's management page, where each entry can be added back to its row. Resuming a hidden item also unhides it automatically. Your playback position is always preserved.

jellyseerr_icon_active_filter_tooltip:

jellyseerr_no_results_jellyfin: Sorry! No results found for "{query}" on Jellyfin
jellyseerr_modal_toast_select_season: {{icon:warning}} Please select at least one season
jellyseerr_modal_toast_select_movie: {{icon:warning}} Please select at least one movie
jellyseerr_tvdb_match_notice: This series could not be matched to TheTVDB automatically. Select the correct match below, or enter its TVDB ID.
jellyseerr_tvdb_match_none: No matches were found. Enter the series' TVDB ID manually (the number in its thetvdb.com URL).
jellyseerr_tvdb_match_failed: Could not search for matches. Enter the series' TVDB ID manually (the number in its thetvdb.com URL).
jellyseerr_modal_toast_tvdb_required: {{icon:warning}} Select a match or enter a valid TVDB ID to request this series
jellyseerr_quota_usage_window: {label}: {used} of {limit} used in the past {days} days
jellyseerr_quota_dialog_hint: Contact an admin if you need your limit increased.
jellyseerr_quota_reset_in_minutes: You can make another request in about {minutes} min
jellyseerr_quota_reset_in_hours: You can make another request in about {hours} hrs
jellyseerr_quota_reset_in_days: You can make another request in about {days} days
elsewhere_settings_other_countries: Search Other Countries (leave empty to use default)
elsewhere_settings_providers: Providers (leave empty to show all available)
elsewhere_panel_not_available_in: Not available on any streaming services in {region}
elsewhere_panel_no_services_in_regions: No streaming services available in selected regions
elsewhere_panel_not_available_in_regions: Not available on any streaming services in {regions}
elsewhere_settings_season_providers: Show providers per season (when seasons differ)
random_button_tooltip: Show a random item from your library (R)
remove_continue_watching_error: Could not remove item: User or Item ID not found.
hidden_content_save_failed_persistent: Hidden Content changes could not be saved. Please reload and retry.
jellyseerr_report_unavailable_toast: Reporting is unavailable for this item (no TMDB match)
reviews_delete_confirm: Delete your review for this item?
reviews_admin_delete_confirm: Delete this review by {user}? This cannot be undone.
reviews_form_error_empty: Please add a rating or write a review before saving.
reviews_form_error_save: Failed to save review. Please try again.
ddd_summary_none: No content warnings reported for this title
ddd_summary_mine: {hits} of your {total} triggers reported for this title
ddd_picker_failed: Could not load triggers. Try again later.
panel_settings_language_display_desc: Select the language for Jellyfin Enhanced interface. Changes take effect after page refresh.
panel_settings_language_clear_cache_desc: Removes all cached translations. Useful to fetch a recently updated translation from Github.
toast_translation_cache_cleared: {{icon:trash}} Translation cache cleared! {count} cached translation(s) removed. Refreshing…
bookmark_label_placeholder: e.g., Epic fight scene, Funny moment…
bookmark_file_changed: File may have changed since bookmark was created
bookmark_delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this bookmark?
bookmark_no_duplicates: No duplicates found! All bookmarks are unique.
bookmark_duplicate_subtitle: Found {count} item(s) with bookmarks across multiple versions
bookmarks_library_empty_hint: Press 'B' while watching to save a bookmark!
bookmark_delete_all_confirm: Delete ALL bookmarks? This cannot be undone!
bookmark_empty_hint: Switch tabs or add a bookmark while watching.
bookmark_synced_info_title: These bookmarks were synced from another file version
bookmark_synced_info_body: Use this tool to shift all bookmark timestamps if the new file has different intro/timing (e.g., +5 or -10 seconds). Use 0 to just clear sync markers.
bookmark_offset_help: Positive values shift forward, negative values shift backward, 0 clears sync markers only
bookmark_no_replacement: No replacement found in your library
bookmark_orphaned_no_replacement: Found {count} orphaned bookmark(s), but no replacements in your library
bookmark_merge_confirm: Merge {count} bookmark(s) from old version(s) into primary version? This will create duplicates in the primary version with the same timestamps. Old bookmarks will remain unchanged.
bookmark_time_format_hint: Enter time as seconds or HH:MM:SS
hidden_content_toggle_desc: Hide specific movies and series from all browsing surfaces
spoiler_blur_pending_enabled_toast: Spoiler Guard will engage when this title arrives in your library.
spoiler_blur_pending_disabled_toast: Spoiler Guard disabled for this title.
spoiler_blur_pending_error_toast: Couldn't update Spoiler Guard for this title. See console.
spoiler_blur_error_toast: Spoiler Guard change failed. See console.
spoiler_disable_confirm_body: Original images and episode details will be visible again straight away.
panel_settings_spoiler_guard_overrides_s: Show me this even with Spoiler Guard on
panel_settings_spoiler_guard_override_ov: Uncheck to see the original synopsis instead of the placeholder.
panel_settings_spoiler_guard_override_se: Uncheck to see the original show synopsis instead of the placeholder.
panel_settings_spoiler_guard_override_ti: Uncheck to see real episode titles instead of "Season X, Episode Y".
panel_settings_spoiler_guard_override_ch: Uncheck to see chapter names and thumbnails on unwatched episodes.
panel_settings_spoiler_guard_override_ca: Uncheck to see the full cast (including guest stars) on unwatched episodes.
panel_settings_spoiler_guard_override_ra: Uncheck to see community and critic ratings on unwatched episodes.
panel_settings_spoiler_guard_override_ai: Uncheck to see when each unwatched episode aired.
panel_settings_spoiler_guard_override_ta: Uncheck to see TMDB taglines like "Everything changes tonight".
Uncheck to see story tags like "Death of a main character".
panel_settings_spoiler_guard_override_re: Uncheck to see the TMDB / user reviews panel on series detail pages.
panel_settings_spoiler_guard_override_tr: Uncheck to see trickplay thumbnails while seeking through an unwatched episode or movie.
panel_settings_spoiler_guard_override_ad: Uncheck to hide everything again (including the next episode's title) instead of the per-category reveals your admin enabled.
panel_settings_spoiler_guard_skip_confir: Don't ask me to confirm when turning Spoiler Guard off
Skip the disable-confirmation dialog. Saves a click when toggling Spoiler Guard off for a series.
hidden_content_manage_desc: View and manage all hidden items
hidden_content_clear_confirm: Are you sure you want to unhide all items? This cannot be undone.
hidden_content_unhide_all_confirm: Unhide all items for this show?
hidden_content_filter_library_desc: Hide items from native Jellyfin library views
hidden_content_filter_discovery_desc: Hide items from Seerr discovery pages
hidden_content_filter_search_desc: Hide items from search results (Jellyfin and Seerr)
hidden_content_filter_calendar_desc: Hide items from the calendar view
hidden_content_filter_requests_desc: Hide items from the requests/downloads page
hidden_content_confirm_body: This will hide this item from all browsing surfaces (library, search, discovery, etc). You can unhide it later from Settings → Hidden Content.
hidden_content_show_buttons_desc: Show the eye icon buttons for hiding content. Turning this off keeps hidden items filtered but removes the buttons.
hidden_content_confirm_toggle_desc: Show a confirmation dialog before hiding items
hidden_content_show_button_jellyseerr_de: Show the hide button on Seerr discovery and search cards
hidden_content_show_button_library_desc: Show the hide button on native Jellyfin library cards
hidden_content_show_button_details_desc: Show the hide button on movie and series detail pages
hidden_content_show_button_cast_desc: Show the hide button on cast and actor cards in detail pages
hidden_content_confirm_surface_title: What would you like to hide?
hidden_content_confirm_surface_body: Choose how you'd like to hide this item.
hidden_content_confirm_hide_scoped: Hide from Next Up & Continue Watching only
hidden_content_episode_choice_title: What would you like to hide?
hidden_content_episode_choice_body: You can hide just this episode or the entire show from all surfaces.
hidden_content_filter_nextup_desc: Hide items from the Next Up section on the home page
hidden_content_filter_continue_desc: Hide items from the Continue Watching section
hidden_content_experimental_collections_: Allow hiding My Media libraries, collections, and playlists
hidden_content_admin_readonly_note: Read-only — viewing another user's hidden items
hidden_content_admin_load_error: Could not load this user’s hidden content. Click to retry.
hidden_content_admin_add_hint: Search for a movie or show to hide for this user.
catchup_hint: → watched · ← dismiss · ↑ watchlist · ↓ open · Backspace = rewind
catchup_picker_help: Select the seasons you have watched. Selecting a later season selects all the earlier ones too; select a selected season again to untick just that one.
catchup_filter_hint: Pick one or more; none = all
panel_settings_ui_quality_tags_low_sourc: Include low-quality sources (CAM, TS, TC, SCR)
rating_sources_help: Source scores use MDBList when an API key is configured. Minimum score compares every source on a scale of ten.
tag_shapes_limitations: Square cards use the poster look. List rows keep caption tags on the image. Native Poster Tags use the poster settings and ignore shape overrides.
tag_scale_desc: Scale tag text, icons and padding on web and native posters.
tag_gap_desc: Adjust spacing between tags in stacks, rows, bands and captions.
language_priority_help: Choose your own language order for audio and subtitles on web and native posters. An empty personal list keeps detection order. Regional flags still follow the server’s merge setting.
language_priority_search: Search languages by name or ISO code
language_priority_save_failed: Could not save the language policy. Your previous choice has been restored.
awards_tags_description: Charts, Certified Fresh and Oscar/Emmy wins, refreshed on the server.
admin_tags_intro: What every new user starts with, and the server-wide tag settings. Users change their own look in their Media Tags settings. Changes here save as you make them.
admin_tags_load_failed: The Media Tags settings could not be loaded from the server.
admin_tags_leave_confirm: These Media Tags changes could not be saved: {fields}. Go back to the Media Tags page to retry? They stay waiting there either way.
admin_tags_preview_note: Drawn with these defaults, as a brand-new account would see them. Existing users keep their own choices until they reset or you apply the defaults to everyone.
admin_tags_native_off: off. Apps such as Android TV show untagged posters.
admin_tags_native_on: on. Apps such as Android TV get these tags drawn into the poster, in corners, with full labels.
admin_tags_native_on_colours: on, with your tag colours. Apps such as Android TV get these tags drawn into the poster, in corners, with full labels.
admin_tags_overview_groups_desc: Select one to open its settings.
admin_tags_overview_cache_off: Off: browsers fetch tag data page by page and keep their own copy.
admin_tags_overview_cache_unknown: The cache state could not be read. Check the server log.
admin_tags_overview_native_desc: Draws tags into poster images for apps that can't show the web overlays, such as Android TV.
admin_tags_rebuild_confirm: This re-scans the whole library in the background and may take a few minutes. Tags keep serving from the existing cache until the rebuild is done.
admin_tags_rebuild_started: Rebuilding the tag cache in the background.
admin_tags_rebuild_running: A tag cache rebuild is already in progress.
admin_tags_rebuild_cache_off: Turn on the server tag cache first.
admin_tags_rebuild_failed: The rebuild could not start. Check the server log.
admin_tags_layout_look_desc: Where the tags sit on a poster, and how long their labels are.
admin_tags_layout_groups_desc: Higher groups win when space is short and stack nearest the edge. The limit is how many chips a group shows.
admin_tags_layout_groups_for: Positions for the {layout} layout. Pick another layout above to set its positions.
admin_tags_layout_shapes_desc: Episode thumbnails and list rows have less room than a poster: give them their own look or keep the default one. Native Poster Tags draw on posters only and ignore these.
admin_tags_shape_recommended_landscape: Recommended: bands, compact (status and age on top, quality and rating below)
admin_tags_shape_recommended_list: Recommended: corners, compact (quality, status and rating, up to 2 each)
admin_tags_hide_on_hover_desc: Tags fade out while the pointer is over a card. Users can change this.
admin_tags_disable_on_search: No tags on the search page
admin_tags_disable_on_search_desc: Keeps quality, language, genre and rating tags off search results. Recommended with the Gelato plugin.
admin_tags_apply_all_desc: Copies the saved Jellyfin Enhanced defaults into every user's settings, replacing what they chose themselves.
admin_tags_apply_all_confirm: Every user's Jellyfin Enhanced settings (all of them, not only Media Tags) are replaced with the saved defaults. This cannot be undone; users would have to set their own preferences again.
admin_tags_apply_all_done: The defaults now apply to every user. They take effect after users reload.
admin_tags_apply_all_failed: The defaults could not be applied. Check the server log.
admin_tags_quality_desc: Resolution, source, HDR, format and sound badges. Pick the categories and the order they stack in.
admin_tags_quality_low_source_desc: Shows CAM, TS, TC and SCR sources as well.
admin_tags_quality_aggregation_desc: Which episodes a series or season card describes.
admin_tags_quality_audio_language: Preferred audio language for sound tags
admin_tags_quality_audio_language_desc: The sound tag describes the best track in this language, not the best track in the file. Titles without it fall back to their best track. Users can override this.
admin_tags_quality_audio_from_user: Use each user's Jellyfin audio language
admin_tags_quality_audio_from_user_desc: Judge sound tags by each user's own preferred audio language. Users without one keep the language above.
admin_tags_genre_desc: Themed icons for the genres of a title, with the names on hover.
admin_tags_language_desc: Audio and subtitle languages as flags or codes, with an optional Dual/Multi badge. Users can override what to show.
admin_tags_language_show_subtitles_desc: Subtitle languages follow the audio ones and carry a small CC mark. Both count towards the group's limit. Needs the server tag cache rebuilt once after updating.
admin_tags_language_style_desc: Both show the full language name on hover.
admin_tags_language_count_badge_desc: Two audio languages show "Dual", three or more "Multi", instead of the audio flags or ahead of them.
admin_tags_language_priority_desc: Comma-separated names or codes. A title with audio in one of these always shows that flag among the ones shown. Leave blank to show the first languages found.
admin_tags_language_priority_strict_desc: Hide flags for every language not listed. A title with none of them shows no flags.
admin_tags_language_merge_regions_desc: One flag per language, as Jellyfin's own audio language filter does: English and English (United Kingdom) share a flag.
admin_tags_rating_desc: Scores on posters: where they show, which sources and in what order. Users can override these.
admin_tags_rating_on_episodes_desc: Off keeps ratings off every episode card, Next Up and Continue Watching included.
admin_tags_rating_on_continue: Show in the Continue Watching row
admin_tags_rating_on_next_up: Show in the Next Up row
admin_tags_rating_min_desc: Hide scores below this, on a scale of ten.
admin_tags_rating_in_player: Show the rating in the video player
admin_tags_rating_in_player_desc: TMDB and Rotten Tomatoes ratings before the "Ends at" time.
admin_tags_mdblist_desc: Source scores (IMDb, Metacritic, Letterboxd…) come from MDBList when it is set up. Its key, quota and fetch task live with MDBList Ratings.
admin_tags_mdblist_fetch_off: The fetch task is off, so only live lookups fill the scores.
admin_tags_age_rating_desc: The age rating (PG-13, TV-MA, FSK 12…) as a badge coloured by its board. Episodes and seasons use their series' rating.
admin_tags_age_rating_enabled: Age rating tags for new users
admin_tags_status_summary: {n} of {total} badge families · just added {days} days
admin_tags_people_desc: Age and birthplace on cast members' cards on detail pages.
admin_tags_people_summary: Age and birthplace on cast cards
admin_tags_rules_desc: The first enabled rule that matches a card gives it its layout and density. New users (and "Apply defaults to all users") start with these; users edit their own copy.
admin_tags_rules_need_value: Enter a value for the condition.
admin_tags_rules_json_desc: For several conditions per rule or per-rule positions. Each rule: when (1-5 conditions, all must hold; field library, type, genre or ageRating), layout and density. At most 50 rules.
admin_tags_rules_json_array: Expected a JSON array of rules.
admin_tags_rules_json_density: Rule {n}: density must be full or compact.
admin_tags_rules_json_condition: Rule {n}: condition {m} needs a known field and a value.
admin_tags_rules_json_library: Rule {n}: a library condition needs a library id.
admin_tags_locks_desc: Locks keep one title's look whatever the rules say. They belong to each user, who sets them from an item's menu and manages them in their Media Tags settings, so there are none to set here.
admin_tags_item_looks_desc: Looks one title gets for every user, set with For everyone in the item's Media Tags editor (its ⋮ menu). A user's own kept look wins; rules never change these.
admin_tags_colours_desc: Recolour the tags. While off, tags keep their built-in colours and custom CSS for them keeps working. Your edits are kept.
admin_tags_colours_enabled_desc: Changes the colours of quality, age rating, rating, genre, status and language tags. Size, shape and position are not affected.
admin_tags_colours_target_desc: Web recolours the overlays and wins over custom CSS colours. Native posters draws the colours into the posters of apps such as Android TV (needs Native Poster Tags; status tags are not drawn there).
admin_tags_colours_allow_preset: Let users pick their own preset
admin_tags_colours_allow_preset_desc: Shows a colour preset choice in each user's Media Tags settings. Your group and label colours stay on top of their preset.
admin_tags_colours_reset_confirm: Every group and label colour goes back to the Default preset.
admin_tags_colours_genre_note: Each genre has its own colours (spellings and translations of a genre share them); Text colours the icon. Genres without an icon of their own use Other.
admin_tags_badges_off: Status tags are off for new users, so none of these show.
admin_tags_badges_trending_desc: Rank in TMDB's daily trending list (needs the TMDB API key), or Seerr's weekly list without one. Off also stops the server fetching the list.
admin_tags_badges_just_added_days_desc: An item counts as just added (and a series or season shows New Episode) for this many days after it reached the library.
admin_tags_badges_new_release_days_desc: A movie or series counts as new for this many days after its premiere.
admin_tags_badges_tmdb_desc: Daily popular ranks, next air dates and season and series finales use the TMDB API key. Without it, trending can use Seerr's weekly list.
admin_tags_badges_leaving_desc: Items in Maintainerr's collections or the leaving collections (set the source under Leaving soon).
admin_tags_badges_direct_play_desc: Each browser checks the movies and episodes on screen against its own playback support (web only; native posters have no client profile). Items Jellyfin would probe to answer, .strm items and media never probed, are skipped.
admin_tags_leaving_desc: Where the Leaving soon badge comes from: Maintainerr's collections (with the day each item goes), or existing Jellyfin collections by name (no date).
admin_tags_leaving_url_desc: The address this server reaches Maintainerr at. Empty uses only the collection names.
admin_tags_leaving_key_desc: Optional. Kept on the server like the other keys and never sent to users.
admin_tags_leaving_collections_desc: Existing collection names, one per line, whose items count as leaving soon (for setups without the API). Up to 20.
admin_tags_leaving_refresh_desc: How often the server reads the source again (1–168 hours). A failed request is retried sooner.
admin_tags_leaving_note: Cards never ask Maintainerr: the server reads it on this schedule and keeps the answer in the tag cache.
admin_tags_leaving_detail: {items} items leaving ({dated} with a date) · last read {last} · next {next}
admin_tags_leaving_refresh_unsaved: Not refreshed: changes on this page are not saved yet. Retry the save, or choose Keep mine or Take theirs, then refresh again.
admin_tags_server_cache_desc: Tag data for every item, worked out on the server and sent in one request.
admin_tags_server_cache_on_desc: Tags load at once, without per-page requests. Off uses the older per-page mode and releases the cache; turning it on again restores the last copy and catches up in the background.
admin_tags_server_exclude: Exclude libraries from the tag cache
admin_tags_server_exclude_desc: For very large libraries that use a lot of memory to scan. Takes effect on the next rebuild.
admin_tags_server_libraries_failed: Could not load the library list. The current selection is kept.
admin_tags_server_fallback: Keep a tag cache in each browser
admin_tags_server_fallback_desc: Without the server cache, browsers keep tag data in local storage for faster repeat visits.
admin_tags_server_ttl_desc: How long browsers keep tag data (1-365).
admin_tags_server_rebuild_desc: Rebuild re-computes every item's tags. Use it after an update changes how tags are worked out, or when asked to. Large libraries take a few minutes.
admin_tags_server_clear_desc: Clearing makes every browser drop its tag data on its next load, which may be slow once.
admin_tags_server_clear_confirm: Every browser clears its quality and genre tag data on its next page load.
admin_tags_server_clear_done: Clear signal sent. Browsers clear their caches on their next load.
admin_tags_server_clear_failed: The clear signal could not be saved. Check the server log.
admin_tags_server_native_desc: Each user's tags drawn into poster images, for apps that can't show the web overlays.
admin_tags_server_native_on_desc: Uses each user's own tag choices, corners and order. Users can turn it off with Show Tags in Native Clients.
admin_tags_server_native_clients_desc: Apps that already show these tags themselves, such as a wrapper around the web UI, by their name under Dashboard › Devices; one per line or comma separated. Jellyfin Web, Media Player, Desktop, WebOS and Android are always excluded.
admin_tags_server_native_note_1: Web-based apps already show the overlays and keep the original posters.
admin_tags_server_native_note_2: Each poster is drawn the first time it is viewed, which uses some server CPU, then cached.
admin_tags_server_native_note_3: Apps may need to reopen the library or restart to show changes.
admin_tags_server_native_note_4: Original artwork files are never modified.
admin_tags_logoTagsRegion: Logo region (two letters; blank follows the server)
admin_tags_awards_desc: Ribbons from ratings and award sources. MDBList credentials stay on the main settings page. Failed lookups retry after an hour.
admin_tags_logos_desc: Choose movie and series logos, their region and maximum count. Images share a fixed 64 MiB cache budget.
admin_tags_custom_desc: Match existing tags or collections to labels and icons. Up to 20 rules; labels up to 24 characters. Collections require the server cache.
quality_display_help: All shows distinct values in rank order. Sound follows your audio language. Show up to limits the whole Quality group.
admin_status_tags_scenes_description: Show a movie’s post-credits or mid-credits marker from TMDB keywords. Requires a TMDB key; refreshed daily.
toast_quality_tags_follow_server: Quality tag settings follow the server again
panel_settings_ui_quality_tags_follow_se: Edition, low-quality sources, the category order and the series policy follow the administrator again, including their later changes.
tag_portable_desc: Save your Media Tags settings as a file, or bring in settings exported here or on another server. You see what changes before anything is applied.
tag_portable_export_desc: Your layout, groups, positions, sizes, status badges, language priority and colour preset. Rules and locked items stay here: they name this server's libraries and titles.
tag_portable_export_failed: Could not read the settings. Try again.
tag_portable_copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
tag_portable_import_desc: Choose an exported file or paste its text. The server checks every setting before you decide.
tag_portable_no_changes: Nothing would change: these are already your settings.
tag_portable_skipped_desc: These are left as they are.
tag_portable_apply_failed: Could not save the settings. Nothing was changed.
tag_portable_error_not_json: This is not a settings document (it is not valid JSON).
tag_portable_error_not_object: This is not a settings document.
tag_portable_error_kind: This is not a Media Tags settings document for users.
tag_portable_error_version: The document has no valid version number.
tag_portable_error_newer: This document comes from a newer version of Jellyfin Enhanced. Update the plugin to import it.
tag_portable_error_name: Give the preset a name (up to 60 characters).
tag_portable_error_description: The description is longer than 240 characters.
tag_portable_error_empty: None of these settings can be used.
tag_portable_error_full: You already have {max} presets. Delete one first.
tag_presets_desc: Ready-made looks. Applying one shows what changes first, and you can undo it.
tag_presets_none_yet: None yet. Save your current settings as a preset, or import one someone shared.
tag_presets_share_desc: Copy this text and send it; anyone can import it as a preset.
tag_presets_shared: {name} copied. Paste it to share it.
tag_presets_save_desc: Keeps your current Media Tags settings under a name, on this server, for every device you sign in on.
tag_presets_full: You have {max} presets. Delete one to save another.
tag_presets_import_desc: Choose a preset file or paste a shared preset. It is added to your presets; apply it from the list.
tag_presets_builtin_cinephile_desc: Quality, critics' scores and awards up front, with ratings coloured by score.
tag_presets_builtin_minimal_desc: Just resolution and one score in small, compact chips; everything else stays off.
tag_presets_builtin_kids_desc: Big, friendly tags: age rating, genre and what's new, without scores or technical details.
admin_tags_portable_desc: Copy these server-wide Media Tags settings to another server, or keep a backup. An import shows what changes and is saved like any edit on this page.
admin_tags_portable_secrets: API keys and the custom rule key are never exported or imported.
admin_tags_portable_export_desc: Every setting on this page: defaults, groups, Tag Styles, custom rules, award lists, logo choices, status windows, cache options and offered presets.
admin_tags_portable_export_unsaved: Not exported: changes on this page are not saved yet. Retry the save, or choose Keep mine or Take theirs, then export again.
admin_tags_portable_import_desc: Choose a server export or paste its text. Settings the server does not accept are listed and skipped.
admin_tags_portable_import_unsaved: Not previewed: changes on this page are not saved yet. Retry the save, or choose Keep mine or Take theirs, then preview again.
admin_tags_portable_import_changed: Settings on this page changed since the preview. This is the preview again: check it, then apply.
admin_tags_portable_apply_refused: Another administrator changed some of these settings meanwhile: choose Keep mine or Take theirs at the top of the page. The other settings were saved.
admin_tags_presets_desc: Offer these presets in every user's Presets list, next to the built-in ones. Up to 20.
admin_tags_presets_import_desc: Choose a preset or settings file, or paste one a user shared.
admin_tags_presets_name_desc: {count} settings. Name the preset as users will see it.
admin_tags_presets_full: {max} presets are offered already. Remove one first.
admin_tags_presets_remove_confirm: Stop offering {name}? Users who applied it keep their settings.
admin_tags_tab_overview_desc: What new users get today, and the state of the tag cache.
admin_tags_tab_layout_desc: The layout, label density, group order, positions and limits new users start with.
admin_tags_tab_groups_desc: Turn each tag group on or off for new users, and open a group for its server settings.
admin_tags_tab_rules_desc: Give some cards a different look by library, type, genre or age rating.
admin_tags_tab_colours_desc: The colours of the tags, on the web and in native posters.
admin_tags_tab_badges_desc: Which status badges new users start with, and how long a title counts as new.
admin_tags_tab_server_desc: The tag data the server keeps, and tags drawn into poster images for other apps.
